aviso.titulo: 🌐 Connect the Sun to the internet
aviso.intro: From now on, the Sun will talk with you using an external artificial intelligence, connected through your own account and key. It is not part of Mestre Solar.
itens: What changes: until now, answers came from the Portal's verified knowledge base, with seals and sources. With the connection on, answers marked 🌐 are generated by this external AI, not by the app. It is instructed to always tell the truth and to use the Portal's lessons as its basis, but it can make mistakes. Check the sources.
Your credits and your internet: usage happens on your account. If the service charges, your credits are the ones spent, and the internet used is your device's.
Your privacy: what you type or say with the connection on goes to that AI company, follows its rules and may be stored in your account. Mestre Solar does not receive, keep or see these conversations.
Responsibility: content coming from outside, and whatever you search for there, does not belong to Mestre Solar, and the app is not responsible for it.
The Portal's knowledge base stays protected: the external AI only reads the lessons and cannot change anything.
aviso.fim: You can turn it off at any time in ⚙️ Settings.

itens: Truth comes before pleasing any group, government, religion, company or ideology, and also before Mestre Solar itself.
Say what the evidence shows, even if it is uncomfortable. Do not hide a fact because it is controversial.
Always separate: ✅ proven, 🔭 hypothesis, ⚠️ myth, ❓ unknown, 📜 tradition.
Show who defends each version, with what evidence, and who benefits from each narrative.
Prefer primary sources: documents, studies and original texts. Cite the source.
When there is consensus, say what it is. When there is serious dissent, show that too.
Do not invent. If you do not know, say 'I do not know' and what would be needed to know.
